cancellation_summary: Please cancel up to 24 hours ahead of time
description:
- Join us as we help keep our beautiful beaches and oceans clean!!
- We are joined by sponsors at each event that, along with us, generously donate items for a raffle that occurs at the end of the clean up!
- Usual locations are either: Ocean Beach, Robb Field in Ocean Beach, Fiesta Island
- Free event open to all ages!
what_is_included:
- Trash bags
- Gloves
- Physical data cards to track items or instructions on how to use the Clean Swell app we contribute data to
- Community partnership
itinerary:
**Please sign SDWW's e-waiver before arriving. Can be found in confirmation email.**
1. Check in (completion of second paper waiver, check in, gathering of supplies)
2. Instructions and opening remarks
3. Beach Cleanup
4. Raffle
highlights:
Join us at some of our beautiful local beaches in San Diego, CA, as we work together to clean up our community! Every month, we focus on a different area, and your participation can make a significant impact on the health of our waterways and oceans.

Here are some important details:

Volunteers of all ages are welcome! Please bring your own reusable cleaning supplies such as buckets, gloves, and grabbers since we are unable to provide them at this time.

On the day of the cleanup, one of our Naturalists will meet you to kickstart your volunteer service.

 We kindly request two things: 
1. Please spread awareness about your efforts by posting a group photo on Facebook or Instagram,
2. Track the trash collected using the CleanSwell app or provided paper datacard. The app's link will be provided in the confirmation email, if applicable.

Feel free to get creative with your photos! Capture moments of you picking up litter, trash in the environment, or proudly displaying full buckets of collected trash.

Don't forget to tag @sdwhalewatch and include the following three hashtags in your posts: #sdwhalewatch, #beachcleanup, #plasticpollution.

Thank you for joining us and helping to keep our rivers, beaches, and oceans clean!
check_in_details:
- To complete the registration process, check-in will begin 10-min start time
- To locate us, please look for the blue pop up tent labeled San Diego Whale Watch/Cruise San Diego and usually the SDWW van with a whale on it. Maps of our approximate location are also included in the confirmation email when you sign up
- Please complete SDWW's e-waiver in your confirmation email for all members in your group before arriving
- A second paper waiver (I Love A Clean San Diego) will be completed upon arrival
what_to_bring:
- Comfortable shoes
- Sun protection
- Hat
- Sunglasses
special_requirements: Everyone participating must sign two waivers: one electronic waiver for our company, SDWW, and one paper waiver for our partner, I Love a Clean San Diego.
disclaimers:
- Please do not pick up anything you are not comfortable grabbing  or anything that looks suspicious or dangerous
- Please remember to read the full confirmation email carefully and not rely solely on email account summaries, as they may provide inaccurate information. For example, incorrect location address
